Maharashtra Food Delivery Warehouses Face Action Over Hygiene Violations

Food delivery service warehouses operated by Zepto, Blinkit, and Swiggy in Maharashtra have faced action due to hygiene violations. Authorities reported finding roaches, rodent droppings, and rotten food at these facilities. Consequently, food licenses and warehouse permits for some of these outlets have been suspended. The crackdown occurred across various locations in Maharashtra, including Nashik.
